summary: Daqo New Energy Corp. filed a Form 6-K on October 13, 2026 (foreign private issuer equivalent of a US Form 8-K), attaching a press release announcing it will report unaudited third-quarter 2026 results before US markets open on October 27, 2026, with a conference call at 8:00 AM ET (8:00 PM Beijing/Hong Kong) and a replay through November 3, 2026. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed. This is a routine earnings-scheduling notice, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle applies.
